audit_items.proof_trace: PackageCallerCap can only be created by app::mint_cap (public(package) — not externally callable), exposed solely through whitelist_admin::mint_new_whitelist which requires AdminCap. Liquidation permission (bit 2) can only be set via update_permission, also gated by AdminCap. AdminCap is issued once at init() with no external constructor, so the assumption forall cap: cap.has_liquidation_permission => cap.issued_by_trusted_admin holds by Move's package-level access control.
